youtube_title: Burnt Your Hand? Toothpaste On It? Stop. Wrong | Body Fix #9 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #9. Touched a hot tawa, and someone says put TOOTHPASTE? Bro, that's wrong.
C is right. Cool RUNNING water, a full 20 MINUTES.
Toothpaste traps heat, ice can damage skin, butter or oil: NO.
Fix: Remove rings or watch, cover loosely, don't pop blisters.
Red flags: Bigger than your palm, on face or hands, or white/charred skin? Go to HOSPITAL.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Burns and scalds
